ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 57
   C. 1
   D. 15

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 122
   D. 22

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 38
   C. 60
   D. 30

5. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

6. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 21

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

12. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. They are equal
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 44

14. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

15. Solve for x: x + 8 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 13
   C. 5
   D. 8

16. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 49

17. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

18. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

19. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 10
   C. 5
   D. 25

20. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27.6

21. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

22. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

23. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

24. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

25. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 17

   C. 0
   D. 16

26. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21

   C. 15
   D. 15.7

27. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 41

28. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12

   D. 42

29. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

30. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1
